The Pizza Lab: Foolproof Pan Pizza

For those interested: I've tried this recipe several times, and it's dead easy and guarantees a good result. I've used different cheese combinations with slightly varying results:

  • Mozzarella: Rather nice texture, but not much flavour
  • Provolone / Mature cheddar: I shredded a 50/50 mixture and the end result was a nice stringy, but bright cheese topping
  • Scamorza / Mature cheddar: Once again I used a 50/50 mix, and it was even more stringy than the Provolone combination. I would definitely recommend this; the scamorza gives the pizza the right amount of stringyness, while the cheddar provides a sharp taste to cut through the tomato sauce.
